method: printed contents p. [vii] (pdf 7); every heading found in text (offset printed+8). Harvard UP 1980 book edition (12th printing 2001). Lectures I (49 pp) and III (50 pp) have no internal section headings, so the planner will split them evenly. The 1980 Preface (pdf 9-29, 21 pp) is substantive (rigid designation restated) - worth re-enabling though it is classed front matter. toc_check warning on Index is OCR spacing ("IND EX") - harmless.
